Fit check: **fits Bugfix** — one root cause, one shared fix point. Implemented.

**Root cause** (per `repro.md`): no `history` integration anywhere. All nav state is `useState` in `src/app/App.jsx`, reset to home on every mount.

**Fix — at the shared path, not the call sites:**

- `src/app/lib/route.js` (new, pure, 36 lines) — address bar ⇄ nav state. `/app/<pipe>/<task>`, plus `?view=inbox|plan|flow` for non-board screens (query param → no id can collide with a view name). Prefix computed per load with the same test `main.tsx` uses, so it works under both `/app/…` and `app.<host>/…`.
- `src/app/App.jsx` (+38) — the five nav states boot from the URL; a `popstate` listener maps URL → state (back/forward work); the writer effect mirrors state → URL. The six open-task call sites (`Sidebar`, `PlanView`, `Inbox`, `Board`, `TaskDetail`, `NewTaskModal`) are untouched — same setters.

Three details worth naming:
- The URL mirrors the **derived** pipeline, not raw `activePipe` — that also kills the secondary bug where refreshing on the 2nd pipeline snapped back to the 1st.
- A task id the project doesn't have clears itself → that pipeline's board, never a blank screen.
- Boot normalisation uses `replaceState`, real navigation `pushState` — no back-button trap.

No router dependency, no server change (deep paths already fall back to `index.html` in Vite, `_redirects`, and electron; every asset/API URL is absolute).

**Regression tests:**
- `src/app/__tests__/route.test.js` — 10 cases: both prefixes, `?view=`, task-without-pipeline, unknown views, encoding, full round-trip.
- `e2e/repro-task-url.spec.js` → `e2e/task-url.spec.js` — rewritten as a regression test, made fixture-agnostic: board URL, task URL, back/forward, refresh reopens the task, cold pasted link, plus inbox-survives-refresh.

```

```

Left alone as out of scope; my spec suppresses the dialog itself. Details in `fix.md`.
